subject: The slider I built at 3AM
preview_text: A quiet feature I wasn't going to ship — but you might actually use
body_paragraphs: At 3AM last week, I built something I wasn't planning to share. Just a slider with no edges, no labels, no noise. It does one thing: lets you boost volume without the app getting in the way.

I didn't tell the team. Didn't design a fancy screen. Just coded it and forgot about it. Then I used it for three days straight — on a podcast, a YouTube video, a game — and realized it's the version I wanted all along.
It's in the app now, buried under settings. No notifications, no upsell. Just the slider, at +200%, and then it disappears. It auto-applies when you plug in headphones. Feels like a secret handshake.
Open Volume Booster Pro, go to Settings, and look for 'Quiet Mode.' Try it once. P.S. — This isn't in the free version. It's a small thank-you for being here.
